title: Fish Industry — Operational Cleanliness and Layout of Market — Guidelines ( First Revision )
clause_1_scope: This standard covers the guidelines for operational cleanliness and layout of market for the fish industry.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Glossary of Important Fish Species of India
Food Hygiene - General Principles - Code of Practice

clause_3_terminology: Operational Cleanliness and Layout of Market

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
